error_original: PageNotFoundError: Cannot find module for page: /teilor-em-numeros
root_cause_detail: Concurrent `next dev` holding `.next` while `next build` ran partially, corrupting webpack chunks. PageNotFoundError during moveExportedPage was a symptom of stale/corrupt `.next`, not missing page source.
remediation: Stop dev server before production build; remove `.next` when chunk errors occur
